description: Server-side risk check for one FindIP Shield session: risk score, recommendation (allow, monitor, challenge, block), whether a challenge was passed, and the session picture (IP, ASN and country rotation, network flags, risk reasons). This is the same check a backend runs before acting on a signup, login or checkout. An unknown session returns verified: false; a session without IP intelligence returns risk_status "unknown", which is not the same as safe. Uses the site secret key from FINDIP_SHIELD_SECRET_KEY.

event.description: Optional event the check is for, for example signup_attempt

session_id.description: Shield session ID sent by the browser SDK (FindIP.getSession().sessionId)

name: verify_session
title: Verify a Shield session
